admission.justification: Proved end-to-end by test_pr_landed_standalone_master_end_to_end_records_finalizes_and_retires, needed for the standalone PR end family, and prevents Managers from manually editing status before finalization or omitting retire_master.

applicability: Manager coordination instructions in skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/reference/coordination/shared/master-state.md for ending a PR-landed standalone master.
conditions: The Manager runs worktree_record_landing, lifecycle_finalize_task without calling task_doc set_status first, and task_doc operation='retire_master' (dry run first) in order.
Finalization never archives a series master; retire_master moves the completed master folder into 0_archive/.
exclusions: Sprint-commanded masters, which retire through their commanding sprint.
Abandoned masters, which follow the abandon section rather than the PR-landed end route.

evidence: skills/l-01-agent-lifecycles/reference/coordination/shared/master-state.md#end-a-standalone-master; scripts/renew-instructions.py --check PASS; test_role_capsule_budgets.py and test_l84_unique_detail_pointers.py PASS

statement: The Manager standalone-master end route documents the three-step sequence worktree_record_landing, lifecycle_finalize_task, and task_doc retire_master in master-state.md without calling task_doc set_status before finalization.
title: Manager three-step end route for a PR-landed standalone master
